description: Server-to-server in-app events posted to api3.appsflyer.com/inappevent, including the JSON event payload.

params.name: app_id
params.description: It is the app identifier from the AppsFlyer dashboard, and it travels in the path. iOS apps must be prefixed with `id`.
params.fix_hint: Put the dashboard app ID in the path after `/inappevent/`. Prefix iOS IDs with `id`.

rules.message: This app ID is digits only. AppsFlyer documents that iOS IDs must be prefixed with `id`; without it the call still returns 200 and the event is not recorded.
rules.fix_hint: Prefix the iOS app ID with `id`, such as `id123456789`.

params.name: appsflyer_id
params.description: It is the AppsFlyer device identifier generated on first launch, and the endpoint requires it.
params.fix_hint: Send the `appsflyer_id` the SDK generated for this install.

params.name: eventName
params.description: Event names cannot start with quote, equals, plus or minus and cannot contain spaces. Custom names remain allowed.
params.fix_hint: Set `eventName` to the event the marketer expects, such as `af_purchase`.

params.name: eventValue
params.description: AppsFlyer documents `eventValue` as required. Send an empty string when the event has no value.
params.fix_hint: Send a JSON object string, or `""` when there is no value.

params.name: att
params.description: It is the iOS ATTrackingManager status. AppsFlyer documents 0 not determined, 1 restricted, 2 denied, 3 authorized.

params.name: advertising_id
params.description: It is the Android GAID. AppsFlyer documents a UUID.
params.fix_hint: Send the GAID as a UUID.

params.name: idfa
params.description: It is the iOS IDFA. AppsFlyer documents a UUID.
params.fix_hint: Send the IDFA as a UUID.

params.name: idfv
params.description: It is the iOS IDFV. AppsFlyer documents a UUID.
params.fix_hint: Send the IDFV as a UUID.

params.name: oaid
params.description: It is the Android OAID, used when GAID is not available. AppsFlyer's sample is a UUID.
params.fix_hint: Send the OAID as a UUID.

params.name: customer_user_id
params.description: It is the advertiser's user id. AppsFlyer documents `customer_user_id` as a unique user identifier set by the app owner.
params.fix_hint: Send `customer_user_id`, or drop the empty pair.

params.name: fb_login_id
params.description: It is the Facebook Login ID. AppsFlyer documents a numeric string.
params.fix_hint: Send `fb_login_id` as digits only, such as `10293847561029384`.

params.name: bundleIdentifier
params.description: It is the app bundle id. AppsFlyer documents it as best practice for campaign optimization.
params.fix_hint: Send the bundle id, such as `com.example.myapp`, or drop the empty pair.

params.name: app_version_name
params.description: It is the public app version name. AppsFlyer documents `app_version_name` on both Android and iOS payloads.
params.fix_hint: Send `app_version_name`, or drop the empty pair.

params.name: consent_data.manual.gdpr_applies
params.description: It is whether GDPR applies. AppsFlyer documents a boolean on the manual consent object.
params.fix_hint: Send `true` or `false` in `consent_data.manual.gdpr_applies`.

params.name: consent_data.manual.ad_user_data_enabled
params.description: It is the ad-user-data consent flag. AppsFlyer documents a boolean on the manual consent object.
params.fix_hint: Send `true` or `false` in `consent_data.manual.ad_user_data_enabled`.

params.name: consent_data.manual.ad_personalization_enabled
params.description: It is the ad-personalization consent flag. AppsFlyer documents a boolean on the manual consent object.
params.fix_hint: Send `true` or `false` in `consent_data.manual.ad_personalization_enabled`.

params.name: aie
params.description: AppsFlyer documents `aie` as a boolean. `true` means the user agreed to share the advertiser ID.

params.name: app_type
params.description: AppsFlyer documents `app_clip` when the event happened in an app clip. Omit the field otherwise.

params.name: os
params.description: It is the device OS version. AppsFlyer documents it as required for correct processing, and assumes iOS 14.5 when it is omitted on iOS.

params.name: eventTime
params.description: AppsFlyer documents UTC as `yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss.sss`. An epoch number is stamped as the arrival time instead.
params.fix_hint: Send UTC as `2019-05-15 12:17:01.123`, with a space, not `T`.

params.name: eventCurrency
params.description: It is an ISO 4217 currency code.
params.fix_hint: Use the three-letter code, such as `USD`.

params.name: email_hashed
params.description: Email must be trimmed, lowercased, and SHA-256 hashed before it is sent.
params.fix_hint: Trim and lowercase the address, hash it with SHA-256, and send the hex digest.

params.name: phone_number_hashed
params.description: Phone must be normalized and SHA-256 hashed before it is sent.
params.fix_hint: Strip symbols and leading zeros, keep the country code, hash with SHA-256, and send the hex digest.

params.name: phone_number_e164_hashed
params.description: An E.164 phone number must be SHA-256 hashed before it is sent.
params.fix_hint: Normalize to E.164, hash with SHA-256, and send the hex digest.

params.name: first_name_hashed
params.description: First name must be lowercased and SHA-256 hashed before it is sent.
params.fix_hint: Lowercase the name, hash it with SHA-256, and send the hex digest.

params.name: last_name_hashed
params.description: Last name must be lowercased and SHA-256 hashed before it is sent.
params.fix_hint: Lowercase the name, hash it with SHA-256, and send the hex digest.

params.name: ip
params.description: It is the device IP address during the event, sent unhashed.
params.fix_hint: Send the device IP, not a SHA-256 digest.

rules.message: A field carries what looks like a raw email address. AppsFlyer documents email as `email_hashed`, SHA-256 hashed on the client side.
rules.fix_hint: Trim the address, lowercase it, hash it with SHA-256, and send it as `email_hashed`.

rules.message: `ip` looks like a SHA-256 digest, but AppsFlyer documents it as the device IP address, unhashed.
rules.fix_hint: Send the raw IP address. Hashing it makes geo matching fail.

rules.message: Android events identified by Android device IDs must include the device operating-system version.
Populate ATTrackingManager status for iOS14 and later. When os is omitted, AppsFlyer assumes iOS14.5.
